cohort_resolution_note: The repo has two overlapping 15-model definitions plus a 16th model (qure, added Nov 24): (A) run_benchmark_suite.py original 15 EDIR/PinPoint models (all except qure); (B) run_transfer_suite.py FIQ_CHECKPOINTS 15 FashionIQ in-domain author checkpoints (all except mtst_ptha, which only has a CIRR transfer checkpoint). To ensure 100% coverage under every interpretation of the '15 model cohort', this probe run evaluates ALL 16 models on EDIR and PinPoint and ALL 15 in-domain (+1 mtst_ptha CIRR-transfer explicitly tagged) on FashionIQ.
